svg.title: Case 9: The Missing Moonstone
svg.text: The Moonstone vanished from the Gallery during a storm.
The visits were in this order: Glasshouse, Gallery, Boathouse.
Each suspect visited a different place and carried a different
container. The Gallery visitor took the Moonstone.
1. Lord Lava visited immediately after the visitor with the drum case.
3. Mummysaurus did not visit the Gallery.
4. The picnic hamper was not at the Boathouse.
